meta.name: Where's My Roy Cohn
meta.description: Roy Cohn personified the dark arts of American politics, turning empty vessels into dangerous demagogues - from Joseph McCarthy to his final project, Donald J. Trump. This thriller-like exposé connects the dots, revealing how a deeply troubled master manipulator shaped our current American nightmare.
meta.slogan: If you were in his presence, you knew you were in the presence of evil
